description: The owner's measured results, re-tested by OCD (rule round 29; O1 of round 18): settled results of the OCD Check owner build on the owner's own phones, from report issues of the owner's account. Each record points at an entry of OCD's data (volte:on, vowifi:on, sms_over_ims:on) with its result class and never carries a value. It never changes carriers/, lookup.json, carrier-variants.json or the Android files, never counts toward round 19's F1 thresholds and is not ROM-citable without R3. On another phone it only moves that entry's test earlier; every phone keeps only what it measured itself. A record lapses after valid_until, 90 days after its last measurement. A correction or a measured failure opens a source review.

levels.L2: calls out: a measured outgoing call on the entry's bearer (round 26, audio from packet counts); incoming not tested
levels.L3: works: also an answered incoming call on the same bearer (round 26 and 27, audio from packet counts); for SMS over IMS, an SMS sent and received over IMS
